fixtureNote: Selected source-backed town archive records from the Providence City of Bywater export.

messages.text: "Waterford was supposed to be but a legend.  I have discovered in my days of research through volumes of forgotten lore that it did exist.  In fact, it lies through a secret cave in the mountains east of here.  Only the best of wines were made there."
You browse through many volumes of text.  If nothing else, you feel more enlightened.
You are standing in the town archives.

"I sought it out many years ago and brought some wine back, but I have not been there in many years.  The exact location of the city is lost to me.  I only recall the way into the Grimwall mountains."
